name: Yasmin
self_text: Hi there! I'm Yasmin, a Nigerian man in my late 20s. When I'm not focusing on photography, I spend a lot of my time on urban gardening, as I love bringing a bit of nature into the city. I use a phone for my photos, and honestly, I'm just looking for a practice session working on specific shots. I tend to go at a slow pace, because that's how I enjoy it. I'm also hoping to find someone to teach me post-processing for my editing. In terms of my schedule, most weeks I can do Saturday morning, Sunday morning or weekday evenings.

requests.request_text: I need you to be the one who teaches me post-processing. You have to be available either Saturday morning, Sunday morning or weekday evenings, and it's a deal-breaker unless you are okay with a slow pace or a moderate pace. I'd strongly prefer that you are into a practice session working on specific shots or a relaxed photo walk, though it's not a requirement.
